raw_response:
I will keep my full 5.0 mu in the usual wheat-maize rotation, because that fits my land, my experience, and my irrigation condition. I have only farmed for 3 years, so I will not make the system complicated. I also have some family labor tied up off-farm, so I want a plan that is steady and easy to manage on time. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put in moderate fertilizer, irrigate a few key times with my well, and keep tillage simple with rotary tillage after maize. For summer maize, I will also use improved seed, push nitrogen a bit more than wheat, irrigate when rain is not enough, and keep pesticide use limited to the times I really need it. I am aiming for stable yield more than taking big risks, because on 5 mu I need reliable production and controlled costs.
